TestUDTEncoding::test_udt.description: On a 3-node cluster (RF=3), creates UDT address(city,zip) and table with map<text, frozen<address>>, inserts a valid UDT literal inside the map, then asserts server-side UDT literal validation: unknown field 'street' and 'cityname' -> "Unknown field '...' in value of user defined type address"; wrong field type (zip as text) -> "Invalid map literal for addresses". Pure single-coordinator CQL validation; no reads, no multi-node behavior.

origin.summary: Cassandra-era 'udt test' (Shawn Kumar), inherited from apache/cassandra-dtest.

TestUDTEncoding::test_udt_change_in_part.description: Creates UDT full_name used as frozen partition key and UDT address used as a regular column; inserts a row; asserts ALTER TYPE full_name RENAME last_name TO surname is rejected (assert_invalid with no message match), and ALTER TYPE address ADD country succeeds. Guards scylla 66e8214606 (Fixes scylladb/scylla#6941): altering a UDT used in a partition key could allow apparent duplicate partitions.

TestUDTEncoding::test_udt_change_in_part.relevance: Live: cql3/statements/alter_type_statement.cc:58-65 rejects any ALTER TYPE (add or rename) when the type is referenced by a partition key column ('Cannot add new field to type ... used in the partition key column ...'). Check is in prepare_announcement_mutations, before make_updated_type, so RENAME hits the same path as ADD.

duplicates.note: Added in the fix commit 66e8214606; ADD on UDT in pk (direct and nested frozen<list<frozen<ut>>>) rejected with message, allowed after table drop. RENAME not explicit but same code path.
ALTER TYPE ADD on non-pk UDT column succeeds (+ data read back).

Note: assert_invalid at udtencoding_test.py:59 has no message match, so any InvalidRequest passes; single-node CQL on 3-node cluster (~18s).
